The '''nuclear engine''' was a type of [[Atmosphere/Legends|atmospheric]] propulsion [[Engine/Legends|engine]] used as a power source for primitive vehicles. The manufacturers of [[Repulsorlift/Legends|repulsorlift]] engines often claimed that primitive engines, such as the nuclear engine, had been rendered obsolete by the advent of the repulsorlift. Despite this, nuclear engines were still in use on less-developed [[Planet/Legends|worlds]].<ref name="SWS">''[[The Star Wars Sourcebook]]''</ref>
